sceneDescription: Titina la tsi tre ɖi na browser sia ƒe Helia node. Wotsɔ node dama siwo le keklẽm la do ka kple web-browser la fifia eye fli le wo dome yi titina. Woke ɖe violet nodes ŋu to browser routing dzi gake womedo ƒome o. Sika nodes nye kadodo siwo le ʋuʋu ɖi siwo ŋu Kubo daemon si le teƒea si le vovo la ka nya ta le; menye web-browser ƒe kadodowoe wonye o eye fli aɖeke mele wo si yi titina sia o. Ɣletivi kuku siwo wotsɔ slate wɔe kpɔa ŋutinya si me kadodo aɖeke mele o ta, eye ne kadodoa metso wo dome ko hafi woɖea woƒe kpeɖodzika ɖa. Adzɔge tso titina ƒe anyigbatatawo dzidze ɣeyiɣi si wotsɔ ɣla; hati siwo womedzidze o xɔa gotagome ɣletinyigba la, eye dzogoewo ƒoa ƒu ɖe ʋuɖoɖo si wokpɔ ŋu. Ɣletivi siwo woɖo atsyɔ̃ na le megbe la metsi tre ɖi na hatiwo o. Gotagome ɣletinyigba si me kɔ o la dea dzesi Kubo ƒe agble si wotsɔ tso duta vɛ eye menye kadodo o. Ne relay ID le hatiwo ƒe hatsotso si wokpɔ me ko hafi relay ƒe nugbɔ dzena; womeƒoa nya ta gbeɖe be hati-to-hati ƒe topology si wowɔ le wo ɖokui si o. Zã peer explorer na nyatakaka mawo ke le nuŋɔŋlɔ ƒe nɔnɔme me.
